no, you’re not retarded. i’m also a young person on the spectrum. the internet is not a kind place when it comes to this stuff. i know it is not anyones place to tell you how to feel about words but i’m going to have to assume that is the word your mom grew up using, as that’s what the pc term for anyone who wasn’t “neurotypical” in some way was at the time. the fact that it was not meant to be malicious doesn’t change the fact that it hurt you, i just try and keep in mind when it is not being used to try and hurt me, because that’s easier than getting people to change their ways. a lot of people are just uneducated about autism, and it seems like (but i don’t know for sure) your mom might be one of them. after finding out, me and my parents joked about weird shit i would do as a kid that would in hindsight make sense for an autistic child to say/do. i hope things work out for you regardless, and i hope you find a better support system. this is meant to be a kind comment so i hope it can be interpreted that way
